# Request fields that can carry a graph uid, and how each is made safe (helpers/uidTrustGuard_test.go).
# path :: Type.Field :: how. A new one is checked MayChange-style (the node's type, parent and owner, in the
# transaction that writes) or replaced from a node the server read, before any write, with a test that holds it.
# A client uid written into a mutation unchecked is a security bug, not a line for this file.
adapter/Chat/chatAdapter.go :: ChatInfo.MediaObjects :: files: reach the graph only as new nodes through dgraphStruct.NewAttachments, which drops the uid and every nested node; helpers/clientFilesGuard_test.go, tests/integration TestAForwardNeverWritesANodeTheRequestNames
adapter/Chat/chatAdapter.go :: InputCreateOrUpdateCommentToChat.MediaObj :: files: reach the graph only as new nodes through dgraphStruct.NewAttachments, which drops the uid and every nested node; helpers/clientFilesGuard_test.go, tests/integration TestAForwardNeverWritesANodeTheRequestNames
adapter/Chat/chatAdapter.go :: InputUpdateReactionForChat.ReactionDgraphUid :: checked by reactionBusiness.MayChange (a Reaction, held by the parent the request names, added by the caller) before any write; controllers/reactionGuard_test.go
adapter/Chat/chatAdapter.go :: InputUpdateReactionForCommentInChat.ReactionDgraphUid :: checked by reactionBusiness.MayChange (a Reaction, held by the parent the request names, added by the caller) before any write; controllers/reactionGuard_test.go
adapter/Doc/docAdapter.go :: CreateOrUpdateDocCommentInput.Attachments :: files: reach the graph only as new nodes through dgraphStruct.NewAttachments, which drops the uid and every nested node; helpers/clientFilesGuard_test.go, tests/integration TestAForwardNeverWritesANodeTheRequestNames
adapter/Doc/docAdapter.go :: InputUpdateReactionForCommentInDoc.ReactionDgraphUid :: checked by reactionBusiness.MayChange (a Reaction, held by the parent the request names, added by the caller) before any write; controllers/reactionGuard_test.go
adapter/Post/postAdapter.go :: InputCreateOrUpdateCommentToPost.MediaObj :: files: reach the graph only as new nodes through dgraphStruct.NewAttachments, which drops the uid and every nested node; helpers/clientFilesGuard_test.go, tests/integration TestAForwardNeverWritesANodeTheRequestNames
adapter/Post/postAdapter.go :: InputCreateOrUpdatePostInfo.MediaObj :: files: reach the graph only as new nodes through dgraphStruct.NewAttachments, which drops the uid and every nested node; helpers/clientFilesGuard_test.go, tests/integration TestAForwardNeverWritesANodeTheRequestNames
adapter/Post/postAdapter.go :: InputDeleteReactionForCommentInPost.ReactionDgraphUid :: checked by reactionBusiness.MayChange (a Reaction, held by the parent the request names, added by the caller) before any write; controllers/reactionGuard_test.go
adapter/Post/postAdapter.go :: InputDeleteReactionForPost.ReactionDgraphUid :: checked by reactionBusiness.MayChange (a Reaction, held by the parent the request names, added by the caller) before any write; controllers/reactionGuard_test.go
adapter/Post/postAdapter.go :: InputDeleteReactionForPostComment.ReactionDgraphUid :: checked by reactionBusiness.MayChange (a Reaction, held by the parent the request names, added by the caller) before any write; controllers/reactionGuard_test.go
adapter/Post/postAdapter.go :: InputUpdateReactionForCommentInPost.ReactionDgraphUid :: checked by reactionBusiness.MayChange (a Reaction, held by the parent the request names, added by the caller) before any write; controllers/reactionGuard_test.go
adapter/Post/postAdapter.go :: InputUpdateReactionForPost.ReactionDgraphUid :: checked by reactionBusiness.MayChange (a Reaction, held by the parent the request names, added by the caller) before any write; controllers/reactionGuard_test.go
adapter/Project/projectAdapter.go :: CreateOrUpdateProjectInput.Attachments :: files: reach the graph only as new nodes through dgraphStruct.NewAttachments, which drops the uid and every nested node; helpers/clientFilesGuard_test.go, tests/integration TestAForwardNeverWritesANodeTheRequestNames
adapter/Task/taskAdapter.go :: CreateOrUpdateTaskCommentInput.Attachments :: files: reach the graph only as new nodes through dgraphStruct.NewAttachments, which drops the uid and every nested node; helpers/clientFilesGuard_test.go, tests/integration TestAForwardNeverWritesANodeTheRequestNames
adapter/Task/taskAdapter.go :: CreateOrUpdateTaskInput.Attachments :: files: reach the graph only as new nodes through dgraphStruct.NewAttachments, which drops the uid and every nested node; helpers/clientFilesGuard_test.go, tests/integration TestAForwardNeverWritesANodeTheRequestNames
adapter/Task/taskAdapter.go :: InputDeleteReactionForTaskComment.ReactionDgraphUid :: checked by reactionBusiness.MayChange (a Reaction, held by the parent the request names, added by the caller) before any write; controllers/reactionGuard_test.go
adapter/Task/taskAdapter.go :: InputUpdateReactionForCommentInTask.ReactionDgraphUid :: checked by reactionBusiness.MayChange (a Reaction, held by the parent the request names, added by the caller) before any write; controllers/reactionGuard_test.go
adapter/User/userAdapter.go :: UserAndChannelFwdMessage.ChannelDgraphUid :: checked in controllers/User FwdUserMessage by GetChannelListWithMemberFlag (has(ch_uuid), the sender in ch_members) and MayPostIn before the write, which takes the uuid and name from that read; tests/integration TestAForwardWritesOnlyWhereItChecked
adapter/User/userAdapter.go :: UserAndChannelFwdMessage.ChatParticipants :: never read from a request: GetChannelsAndUsers answers with this struct, and the forward reads only the destination ids
adapter/User/userAdapter.go :: UserAndChannelFwdMessage.GrpDgraphUid :: replaced in FwdUserMessage from the group read by its grouping id (the sender a participant) before the write; tests/integration TestAForwardWritesOnlyWhereItChecked
adapter/User/userAdapter.go :: UserAndChannelFwdMessage.UserDgraphUid :: replaced in FwdUserMessage from the person read by their uuid (sendBusiness.MayMessage) before the write; tests/integration TestAForwardWritesOnlyWhereItChecked
adapter/User/userAdapter.go :: UserFwdMsgInput.Attachments :: files: reach the graph only as new nodes through dgraphStruct.NewAttachments, which drops the uid and every nested node; helpers/clientFilesGuard_test.go, tests/integration TestAForwardNeverWritesANodeTheRequestNames
controllers/Doc/docAccessController.go :: legacyUser.Uid :: an answer, never decoded from a request: the share dialog reads people in this shape (legacyOf)
